description: The recognition analytics Bonusly reserves for admins -- rebuilt from data any employee can already read.

tools.name: balance_show
tools.description: Your current giving/redeemable balance, monthly budget, and lifetime stats. Returns the Balance.

tools.name: company_show
tools.description: Company metadata: name, locale, plan, feature flags, subscription state. Returns the Company.

tools.name: departments_list
tools.description: List departments with per-department user counts. Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of Department.

tools.name: departments_users
tools.description: List users belonging to a department (exact match). Required: department. Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of User.

tools.name: locations_list
tools.description: List locations with per-location user counts. Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of Location.

tools.name: locations_users
tools.description: List users belonging to a location (exact match). Required: location. Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of User.

tools.name: org_chain
tools.description: Walk the manager chain upward from a user, closest-first. Required: user. Returns array of User.

tools.name: org_reports
tools.description: List users who report directly to a given manager. Required: manager. Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of User.

params.name: manager
params.description: Manager's user id, email, or name

tools.name: org_top
tools.description: List users with no manager (org-chart entry points). Optional: search, cursor. Returns array of User.

tools.name: org_tree
tools.description: Walk the reporting tree downward from a user. Required: user. Optional: depth (default: 1). Returns the ReportingTree.

params.name: depth
params.description: How many layers deep to walk (max 5)

tools.name: recognition_create
tools.description: Give recognition. reason must be the full mini-DSL string: '+N @mention #hashtag your message' -- the promoted 'give' command synthesizes this from structured flags; this raw endpoint is the low-level passthrough. Required: reason. Optional: parent-bonus-id. Returns the new Recognition.

tools.name: recognition_delete
tools.description: Delete (undo) a recognition you gave, within 24 hours of creation. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: recognition_feed
tools.description: List/browse the company recognition feed with filters. Optional: limit (default: 20), start_time, end_time (plus 5 more). Returns array of Recognition.

params.name: start_time
params.description: ISO 8601 start of date range (confirmed param name)

params.name: end_time
params.description: ISO 8601 end of date range (confirmed param name)

params.name: giver_email
params.description: Filter by giver's email (confirmed param name)

params.name: receiver_email
params.description: Filter by a receiver's email (confirmed param name)

params.name: user-email
params.description: Filter to recognition involving this user as giver or receiver (confirmed param name)

params.name: hashtag
params.description: Filter by hashtag; leading # is optional (confirmed param name)

params.name: include_children
params.description: Include add-on/comment rows inline (confirmed param name)

tools.name: recognition_get
tools.description: Get a single recognition by id. Required: id. Returns the Recognition.

tools.name: recognition_given
tools.description: List recognition given by a user. Required: giver_email. Optional: start_time, end_time, limit (default: 20). Returns array of Recognition.

tools.name: recognition_group-count
tools.description: Resolve a group (department/location/team) and count how many recipients a post would reach. Required: group_name. Optional: cursor. Returns the GroupRecipientCount.

params.name: group_name
params.description: Group name: 'everyone', a department, a location, or '<manager>'s team'

tools.name: recognition_last-given
tools.description: Get when you last gave recognition to each of a batch of users (max 20 ids). Required: user-ids. Returns array of LastGivenEntry.

tools.name: recognition_list-types
tools.description: List the recognition-type values accepted by feed filters (celebrations, awards, incentives, peer, external_recognition). Returns array of RecognitionType.

tools.name: recognition_received
tools.description: List recognition received by a user. Required: receiver_email. Optional: start_time, end_time, limit (default: 20). Returns array of Recognition.

tools.name: recognition_update
tools.description: Edit a recognition you gave, within 24 hours of creation. reason REPLACES the entire message -- include the +amount, @mentions, and #hashtag you want to keep. Required: id, reason. Returns the updated Recognition.

tools.name: redemptions_get
tools.description: Get a single reward redemption by id (your own, or any if you have rewards-admin). Required: id. Returns the Redemption.

tools.name: redemptions_list-mine
tools.description: List your own reward redemptions, newest first. Optional: limit (default: 20), cursor. Returns array of Redemption.

tools.name: users_get
tools.description: Resolve a single user by id, email, or display name. Required: identifier. Returns the User.

params.name: identifier
params.description: User id, email, or full display name

tools.name: users_get-bulk
tools.description: Bulk-fetch users by a list of user IDs. Required: ids. Returns array of User.

tools.name: users_me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's own profile. Returns the User.

tools.name: users_search
tools.description: Search users by name or email, with optional department/location filters. Optional: query, department, location (plus 1 more). Returns array of User.
